title: Plaque Assay
author: Alice Lee
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.be6sjhee
materials: Grow the bacteria on 37 °C shaker overnight.

steps.title: Prepare Overnight Bacterial Culture
steps.instruction: Grow the bacteria associated with the phage of interest one day before the assay.

substeps.instruction: Retrieve a streaked bacteria plate from the 4 °C room.
Aseptically transfer 2 mL of BHI media into a snap cap tube.
Use a disposable inoculating loop to scrape a colony from the streak plate and transfer it into the BHI media tube.
Incubate the tube in the 37 °C incubator room on a shaker set to 200 rpm.

steps.title: Prepare Log-Phase Bacteria
steps.instruction: On the day of the experiment, transition the overnight culture to fresh media to reach log-phase.

substeps.instruction: Aseptically add 2 mL of fresh BHI media into a new snap cap tube.
Transfer 100 µL of the overnight culture into the new BHI media tube.
Incubate the tube in the 37 °C incubator room on a shaker at 200 rpm for ~3 hours or until the sample becomes cloudy.
Retrieve the required number of BHI plates from the 4 °C incubator room.
Wipe the hood with 70% ethanol.
Place plates in the hood with lids halfway open to dry out liquid droplets.

steps.title: Perform Serial Dilution of Phage Stock
steps.instruction: Perform a serial dilution of the phage stock to determine its concentration.

substeps.instruction: Thaw the phage stock tube from the -80 °C freezer at room temperature.
Perform a 1:10 dilution: add 10 µL of stock phage into 90 µL of SM buffer in a 1.5 mL tube and mix well.
Perform a 1:100 dilution: add 10 µL of the 1:10 dilution into 90 µL of SM buffer in a 1.5 mL tube and mix well.
Continue serial dilutions for the required number of samples.
Prepare a negative control: add 10 µL of Ultra Pure Water (UPW) into 90 µL of SM buffer in a 1.5 mL tube.

steps.title: Prepare Top Agarose
steps.instruction: Prepare and cool the BHI + 0.35% LMP agarose.

substeps.instruction: Microwave a bottle of BHI + 0.35% LMP agarose until it boils (start with 00:00:30 and increase gradually to prevent boil over).
Allow the media to cool down to avoid heat-shocking the bacteria.

steps.title: Infect Bacteria and Plate
steps.instruction: Combine log-phase bacteria with diluted phages and plate using the top agarose.

substeps.instruction: Label a glass culture tube for the sample.
Add 100 µL of log-phase bacteria and 10 µL of the phage dilution into the glass tube; let sit for 15-20 minutes.
Aseptically transfer 3.5 mL of cooled BHI + 0.35% LMP agarose into the glass tube and mix by pipetting up and down slowly to avoid bubbles.
Transfer the contents onto a dried BHI plate and swirl to disperse.
Place the plate on the leveled green taped X mark on the sink counter to solidify.
Repeat for all samples, including the negative control.

steps.title: Incubate and Analyze Results
steps.instruction: Incubate the plates and calculate the phage concentration.

substeps.instruction: Store solidified plates upside down in the 37 °C incubator overnight.
Observe plates the next day and identify a plate with a countable number of plaque forming units (PFU).
Count the number of plaques on the plate.
Calculate concentration using the formula: PFU/uL = Number of Plaques Counted / (Dilution x Volume of Diluted Virus Added).
